content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. 💪 Research shows that lighter loads (roughly 30% of your 1RM and up) build similar muscle size to heavy loads, as long as you take sets close to failure and get enough total volume.

Your goal is a 100 kg bench in three months, and that's different. Strength is specific, so you'll need to practice heavy singles, doubles and triples to get there. Use heavier work (1-5 reps) for your main bench and higher reps (8-15) on accessories for size. Ain't nothin' but a peanut! 🔥
